leaves.doc: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971), section 3.5, Thm 3.52 (number UNVERIFIED; also Diamond-Im 1995 section 12.3, Diamond-Shurman section 6.5 for k = 2), printed form: for every N >= 1 and every weight k >= 2, S_k(Gamma_1(N)) (Mathlib CuspForm on Gamma1 N: a = d = 1, c = 0 mod N) has a basis over C of cusp forms whose Fourier coefficients at infinity (q-expansion, period 1) are rational integers. Replaces gamma1IntegralSpan, which follows by basis => span (Gamma1Basis.gamma1IntegralSpan_of_basis, proved; the converse gamma1IntegralBasis_of_span is also proved, so the two are equivalent).
